result.summary: Found 1 major issue: a raw localization key is visible as a section title, plus a minor inconsistency in favorite-icon styling.

issues.description: Section header below 'Fastest near you' displays raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the proper localized string (e.g., 'Popular near you') and add a fallback / QA check for missing translations

issues.description: Favorite heart icon on 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card has no dark circular background while the heart icon on the pizza card below does, creating inconsistent styling
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent circular scrim/background to all favorite icons for visibility and visual consistency
